notes: One blocking finding reached this stage and it is repaired; CARRIED_FINDINGS was empty; the four ADVISORY_FINDINGS (SYN-016 to SYN-019) gate nothing and are owed no disposition, and all four are cleared. SYN-015: sections/concise/04-themes.tex opened its account of the Introit with 'in two half-verses of the long alphabetical psalm on God's law'. propers/verified.md records the construction at marginal no. 1602 as 'Verse 137 entire, then the first half of v. 124 only', and the expansive study says the same at sections/10-each-element.tex; the sentence was also contradicted by the clause immediately after it in its own paragraph. It now reads 'in one whole verse of the long alphabetical psalm on God's law and in the first half of another', and the following clause's 'the words that complete verse 124' reads 'the words that complete it', the verse having just been named. No evidence was re-derived: the repair states what the collation and the accepted study already state. SYN-016: the Hilary/Augustine disagreement at the Introit now carries one of the study's two orienting clauses, 'Hilary, writing before the controversy with the Pelagians', as sections/40-just-judge-merciful-hearer.tex and research/scope.md 4.11 have it; both witnesses were already kept and Hilary was never cited for Augustine's point. SYN-017: 'Chrysostom reads them instead of the one God and Father' now reads 'Chrysostom instead reads them of the one God and Father', the study's own idiom for the Greek commentators, so 'instead' governs the verb and cannot reach the one God and Father. SYN-018: the page-one note's 'it has the one oration above and admits no optional text', which appeared to deny the three orations the map prints above it, now reads 'it says one set of orations and admits no commemoration', the rubrical sense sections/00-opening.tex states. SYN-019: the Gradual's 'What it says' cell restores the first half of the respond and reads 'Blessed the nation whose God is the Lord, the people he chose for his inheritance', as the study's map has it. Two compensating compressions paid for the additions inside the same components, because the Gradual's third line pushed the overview table off the fixed page one and the commentary's two added lines carried the colophon to a thirteenth page: the Secret's summary in the map is shortened to one line (the themes section states that petition in full with its exuant two pages later), and the commentary's clause 'and it prints them against their own order in the psalm' is dropped, the themes section already stating the inversion in full with both verse numbers on page 4. Neither costs an attribution, a locus, a disagreement or a qualification. No new evidence-dependent claim was added and no upstream defect was found, so none is reported.
